props.gloss_en: Beit Shammai: one washes the hands and afterwards mixes the cup
Beit Shammai: for if you say the cup is mixed first -- a decree lest the liquids on the back of the cup become impure through his hands and in turn defile the cup
and a second does not make a third in non-sacred food except through liquids
Beit Hillel: one mixes the cup and afterwards washes the hands
Beit Hillel: for if you say the hands are washed first -- a decree lest the liquids on the hands become impure through the cup and in turn defile the hands
Beit Hillel, another reason: immediately upon washing the hands, the meal
a vessel does not defile a person
here we deal with a vessel whose back was defiled by liquids, whose inside is pure and whose back is impure
the mishnah: a vessel whose back was defiled by liquids -- its back is impure; its inside, its rim, its ear and its handles are pure
the mishnah: if its inside was defiled, all of it is defiled
Beit Shammai hold it is forbidden to use a vessel whose back was defiled by liquids
Beit Shammai: a decree because of drips
Beit Shammai: and there is no [need] to decree lest the liquids on the hands become impure through the cup
Beit Hillel hold it is permitted to use a vessel whose back was defiled by liquids
Beit Hillel say: drips are not common

supports.gloss_en: דתנן: כלי שנטמאו אחוריו במשקין אחוריו טמאים, תוכו... טהורין -- such a vessel's inside is pure while its back is impure (kind svara: no SupportKind names a cited mishnah)

objections.gloss_en: וליטמו ידים לכוס! -- let the hands defile the cup [directly]; why speak of the liquids on its back?

answered_by.gloss_en: ידים שניות הן, ואין שני עושה שלישי בחולין אלא על ידי משקין -- hands are second-degree, and a second makes a third in non-sacred food only through liquids (= p_yadayim_shniyot, p_ein_sheni_oseh_shlishi)
